items.quote:
This evening, I will be voting to advance the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act. 

Over 90% of Kansans agree — men and boys shouldn’t be competing in women’s and girls’ sports. 

Let’s end this insanity once and for all.
Our Credit Card Competition Bill will cut gas and groceries by 2 to 3%.

Patients deserve price tags, not surprise bills. 

The Patients Deserve Price Tags Bill is the only bill that will lower the cost of living. Next stop: Senate floor.
My bill, the CMV English Proficiency Act, will save lives by requiring English proficiency tests before issuing a CMV license.
The reconciliation package is a good first step, but it’s only the beginning.
President Trump’s gambit to end Russia’s war in Ukraine by pressuring the victim is certain to fail.
Regardless of the midterm election results, Mr. Putin is America’s enemy.
With the 152nd running of the Kentucky Derby this Saturday, the President’s decision to roll back tariffs on bourbon and whiskey is timely and welcome news.
This is not a $1.5 trillion dollar defense appropriations request. It’s a request for $1.1 trillion in base appropriations and another $350 billion in reconciliation.
But as I warned publicly at the time, Israel needed more than just rhetorical solidarity.

Earlier this month, I led eight of my Republican colleagues in urging FEMA to end the Biden-era Risk Rating 2.0. I want to work with the President to fix the mess the Biden administration has created.
We, under this plan, would give up to $2,000 to a family of four in a prefunded health savings account, and you add that to price transparency.

Only American citizens should vote in American elections. This is basic common sense. I will proudly cosponsor the SAVE Act, which requires proof of citizenship to register and protects the integrity of our elections.
items.promise: Said he will cosponsor the SAVE Act requiring proof of citizenship to register to vote.

items.quote: I will not stop working until the Social Security Fairness Act is implemented and state and local public servants get the Social Security benefits they deserve.
items.promise: Said he will keep working until the Social Security Fairness Act is implemented.

items.quote: I've spoken to multiple people I respect about Kash Patel this weekend—both for and against. The ones who worked closely with Kash vouched for him. I will vote for his confirmation.
Today, I will vote with President Trump to support our soldiers against the anti-American Iranian regime.
I agree with President Trump that the Department of Education has failed its mission.
Mr. President, I rise today to underscore the critical importance of maintaining temporary protected status, or TPS, for Haiti.
The Court failed a test of morality.
I will not support any funding deal that puts money in the hands of Stephen Miller, Kristi Noem, and this violent agency.
items.promise: Said he will not support any funding deal that funds ICE under its current leadership.

items.quote: Today, I introduced the No Cuts to Public Schools Act to protect federal funding for public schools from Trump and McMahon’s pro-privatization, anti-student crusade.

The House’s 10-year ban on state AI regulation would wreak havoc on our country. The language is so broad that it could upend everything from state privacy law to contract law. It could even break the internet.
After careful consideration, I have decided to vote against Pete Hegseth’s nomination for Secretary of Defense.

The conflict between how the State of Maine and the Administration interpret Title IX needs to be resolved.  I agree with the federal government’s position that biological males should not compete in girls and women’s athletics.
Today, I cast my 10,000th consecutive roll call vote, extending the unbroken voting streak that I have maintained throughout my entire Senate service.

Yesterday, I pressed the U.S. Trade Representative on how the tariff on steel and aluminum is driving up costs for Maine’s lobster and blueberry industries, and I urged that these iconic Maine industries be exempted.
